subject: Textures delta final: Vk83 oracle, 17-layer mip transport, depth/integer sampler parity, 806 checks
body: Delta complete. (1) Vk83: n2r case83 matches vertex_fetch (207<<12)|16; new full ATTRIBUTE v9 oracle test passes. (2) Mip/layer: helper tests positive 5-level 2D, 3 layersx4 levels, cube6x3, 3D depth4x3, 17-layer array; explicit >16 level, >2048 layer, >256 subresource refusals. Exact compute calls posted: fill layout.level[0..levels-1]; n2t_layout_check(l,0,declared_span); n2t_layout_pack_sampled/storage(...) emits all layersxlevels layer-major/level-minor, or per-entry n2t_layout_subresource+n2t_plane_pack. Compute TDG2 levels>1 and 16-plane bound remain compute-owned. (3) Sampler: compare restricted to depth views (color compare -15), depth compare packed/tested, depth border refused; integer views require nearest/no linear mip/aniso (else -15), integer custom border requires raw uint32; custom float border/presets/LOD min-max-bias tested. Gradients are shader/NIR, not a sampler descriptor field (ledger says not claimed). Latest production helper 806 checks PASS release+ASan/UBSan; n2r suite 9 lines PASS release+ASan; freestanding no undefined; ARM64 render/bridge compile. Current hashes in STATUS. Other-owner: compute frontend line736 pointer-bool compile error and unguarded legacy exact-factory risk; bridge explicit zero-RRRR validity/view-format sampler; compute mip wire. No phone/build/commit/publish.
